sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
The cube rolls in this order: west, north, north, south, west, south. Which emblem finishes on top?
A. Triangle
B. Sun
C. Cross
D. Circle
E. Bars
F. Diamond
sample.analysis: Track the orientation after each roll ['west', 'north', 'north', 'south', 'west', 'south']. The final top face is R, carrying the Triangle emblem. The answer is A.
